result:
The proposed answer is incorrect, because it asserts β = α without deriving anything. The correct order is β = 1/α.

Sibson's mutual information is

I_α(X;Y) = (α/(α−1)) log ∫ ( Σ_x P(x) p(y|x)^α )^{1/α} dy.

As snr → ∞, the Gaussian densities p(y|x) centered at distinct support points become essentially disjoint. The sum inside the integral is then dominated by a single term at each y, so

( Σ_x P(x) p(y|x)^α )^{1/α} ≈ Σ_x P(x)^{1/α} p(y|x).

Integrating over y, each p(y|x) integrates to 1, which gives Σ_x P(x)^{1/α}. Hence

I_α(X;Y) → (α/(α−1)) log Σ_x P(x)^{1/α}.

The Rényi entropy of order β is H_β(X) = (1/(1−β)) log Σ_x P(x)^β. Setting β = 1/α gives 1/(1−1/α) = α/(α−1), which matches the coefficient above. So the limit is H_{1/α}(X), and the proposed answer β = α is wrong.

VERDICT: REJECT
